# Recorded AI review milestones

This log records actual task messages, inspected artifacts and corrections. The
milestones are asynchronous work checkpoints, not invented meetings, independent
human experts, peer review or conference acceptance. Repeated agreement among
model agents is not human annotation reliability or independent evidence for a
source's claims.

The participating functions are source reconciliation, quantitative methods,
speech recognition, source reading, interface design and independent criticism,
coordinated by the root agent. They are roles performed by AI agents, not claims
of professional credentials. The three planned milestones are protocol/design
critique, executed-output/source criticism, and correction/release verification.

## Milestone 1 — protocol and selection critique

**Executed.** The source-reading candidate list was frozen at
2026-11-08 18:31:46 UTC in [selection-plan.json](selection-plan.json), before that
role inspected new channel-lab similarity or topic results.

Actual review exchanges established the following:

- **Quantitative methods:** freeze cases before inspecting new rankings; preserve
  printed Q/A, analyst questions and ASR cues as separate objects. Shared printed
  names are selection criteria, not independent confirmations. Retain conditions,
  time, uncertain speakers and a nearby nonmatching example. The role proposed a
  falsifiable Mary/Magdalene comparison across medium and length conditions; a
  stable ordering could still reflect source style, while a reversal would reveal
  fragility. Source-balanced summaries remain descriptive; overlapping pairs
  cannot supply an independent sample size or ordinary pair-level p-values.
- **Independent criticism:** require actor, proposition, referent, conditions,
  time, genre and exact edition for every comparison. A missing explicit answer
  is not disagreement. The useful contribution is an auditable source-aware
  workflow, not new evidence that named beings exist. The reviewer read the actual
  frozen candidate plan and requested both repeated-name cases, one
  refusal/correction example and any tension for later decisive-source checks.
- **Speech recognition:** the nine-recording selection is operational and
  purposive: five retained OmNa publications plus the shortest eligible
  not-yet-upgraded recording in each of four other contexts. The frozen plan is
  7,956.60625 seconds (132.61 minutes), 269 windows, and no new media acquisition.
  Seven prior canonical S16 hashes matched; official Bashar and Athina required
  newly frozen canonical decodes, so no prior S16 match was claimed for those two.
  At this plan-stage message inference had not launched. Model size, fluency and
  output differences cannot establish channel-wide recognition accuracy.
- **Interface design:** recording details must distinguish computed metrics from
  paraphrased readings and show reading coverage. Canonical source/channel IDs
  and same-versus-alternative edition labels are required. Existing question IDs
  are needed for the previous knowledge-bank deep links; a card ID alone does not
  create a working question link.
- **Source reconciliation:** canonical Council texts remain accepted baseline
  editions; new recognition is a separate comparison. Written pilot bodies stay
  primary, and inspected body-only written text can take precedence over its
  audio ASR. Publication, recording, edition, publisher, medium and printed label
  are distinct units.

These constraints were incorporated into [PROTOCOL.md](PROTOCOL.md), the
reading generator and public schema. Twelve purposeful candidates were retained
in the selection plan, including a skeptical-reception context and documentary
refusal/correction controls. The plan does not claim representative sampling.

## Milestone 2 — executed readings and source criticism

**Executed and independently reviewed for the stated scope.** The
source-reading role inspected exact retained passages and built twelve cases.
The candidate covers 10,006 unique words in 22 of 493 canonical source units,
including five complete short bodies, across nine of 26 modeled publisher
contexts. Three additional Parakeet editions contribute 2,124 separately
inspected words; they do not enter primary-case support or its word denominator.

Actual checks and exchanges at this stage:

- The source owner confirmed that the primary Council frame retains old ASR
  editions. The reading role therefore re-read exact baseline supports for its
  cases and retained its fresh Parakeet passages as explicitly noncanonical
  additional-edition reading. The independent reviewer separately raised this
  same edition-boundary concern after inspecting the passage metadata. No
  noncanonical character offset was presented as a baseline location.
- The frozen Passion Principle selector was an excluded duplicate publication.
  Its complete normalized text exactly matches the selected canonical edition.
  The generator requires the explicitly reviewed complete-body alias; it does
  not manufacture a second observation or silently choose a similar neighbor.
- A historical skeptical-window field named `text_sha256` bound the JSON
  artifact rather than the normalized body. The actual canonical body and exact
  inspected span were independently checked and the distinction recorded in a
  fresh private inspection edition. The text and selected window did not change.
- The candidate preserves a conditional Mother Mary tension only under an
  explicitly changed trust referent. It records distinct Magdalene practice
  frames, optional mediation compatibility, and refusals/corrections as
  documentary dialogue outcomes. All twelve comparison questions are analyst
  questions; actual printed Ra question IDs remain separate evidence metadata.
- The candidate was sent to interface design with all source/channel IDs,
  evidence locators, existing question links, conditions and counter-readings.
  All 26 channel-note records disclose whether new substantive reading occurred;
  computed features do not inflate reading coverage.

The independent role verified all 52 exact inspected spans: 46 primary supports
and six alternative-edition supports. It reproduced the canonical coverage,
checked all twelve complete printed Ra question/response joins after the declared
normalization, and matched the alternative evidence to the accepted full-ASR
artifacts and canonical audio hashes. Its fresh semantic re-reading covered
16 decisive spans / 2,512 words across Mary, Magdalene, time-reference and
refusal/correction cases. It reported no substantive correction to those scoped
paraphrases. This is not a claim that it semantically read every corpus document.
Receipts are retained privately as `review/readings-independent.json` and
`review/readings-alternate-independent.json`.

The methods role then challenged the executed findings: say “no explicit
contradiction established in these twelve purposive cases,” not general corpus
agreement. Keep Mary's altered-referent tension as an alternative reading, not a
scored contradiction; neither Magdalene's different emphasis nor optional
mediation compatibility establishes identical answers. Refusal/correction cases
must continue to distinguish question premises from affirmative teachings. The
role is adding its previously proposed four-source comparison to the common fit;
that numerical output is separate from this source-reading audit.

The speech role reported an executed and independently cleared two-window pilot:
60 seconds of input, 94 recognized words, a 13.43513-second stage and 6.802 seconds
of worker overlap, with full encoder-frame coverage. The main nine-recording
batch launched at 18:42:47 UTC. At the actual 18:49:32 update, 123 of 269 windows
were ready (121 new and two verified pilot cache hits), with no failures. That
update did **not** establish full-batch completion or recognition accuracy.

## Milestone 3 — correction and release verification

**Reading correction and verification completed; broader release checks remain
separate.** The source frame
was rebound from edition 01 to edition 02 after the owner repaired 67 official
audio metadata joins. All 493 ordered source IDs, body hashes, word counts and
selected edition IDs were unchanged; reading intervals did not move. The
generator rejects an ambiguous identity join, changed body, invalid support,
changed-edition card inheritance or missing candidate disposition, and emits an
explicit public byte/hash allowlist. Private exact evidence is excluded.

Three reading integration controls were executed and passed: overlapping spans
count their word union once; a changed edition cannot inherit old character
support; and a frozen candidate cannot disappear without a disposition. The
final metadata-only reading rebind passed independent verification at
18:48:39 UTC. Its accepted public SHA-256 is
`46a25899c74d7af30b118fa6a9e7280a70443d650db72ce09305b7ba7a599b2b`;
the final receipt is `review/readings02-independent.json`. This binds the same
52 inspected spans and the final metadata frame; no unsupported semantic rewrite
was required. All twelve frozen cases have a disposition, and the public artifact
contains no raw transcript bodies or local evidence paths.

Independent numerical, full-batch and actual UI release checks retain their own
scopes and status; they are not implied by the reading tests. The last batch
status recorded above is a progress snapshot, not a final collection total. Later
acceptance and remaining limits should be appended only after those roles produce
their corresponding records.

### Numerical and speech completion added after review

The independent numerical audit passed at **18:58:50 UTC**. It checked the
493-source common fit with fresh lexical count/vocabulary fits and manual IDF,
all six neighbor controls, all 2,704 publisher-context matrix cells, normalized
NMF reconstruction and seed comparisons, and fresh projection arithmetic. The
largest reported numerical difference was approximately `2.84e-14`. Saved neural
vectors were checked; the reviewer did not run a second neural encoder. The
private receipt is `review/analysis-independent.json`; it binds the public
[analysis artifact](../../dist/channel-lab/analysis.json), SHA-256
`59f08dddc1b72bc3ed9b70c41f515a91a5e6bdb3ad427a9a0048deb62390635a`.

The source-reading role then inspected the accepted results and challenged their
interpretation before any release summary:

- Publisher-macro top-five neighbor Jaccard is **0.3202** between lexical and
  neural representations and **0.0507** between full and centered, at-most-300-token
  neural representations. The latter changes content as well as length; it is
  not an isolated length effect or an accuracy score.
- Mean neural similarity is **0.5280** for cross-publisher document pairs,
  **0.6619** for publisher-context pairs and **0.5557** for creator-context pairs.
  These summaries change eligible pair composition and the aggregation unit.
  They are not three unbiased estimates of a single population parameter;
  overlapping pairs remain dependent.
- The four preselected Mary/Magdalene sources have a positive average
  within-creator-minus-same-label-cross-creator contrast in all four views.
  However, Natalie's full-neural within-creator pair (**0.4626**) is below both
  same-label cross-creator pairs (**0.5128**, **0.5619**). Two dependent pairs per
  side cannot establish universal dominance or authenticate an entity.
- Topic terms retain conversation, identity and promotion cues, including
  `yeah`, `bashar` and `new book`. The critic highlighted one seed-47 matched
  factor cosine of **0.2878**, despite a mean of **0.8979**. The release therefore
  does not describe all factors as stable or identify eight true doctrines.

A separate source-reading-role arithmetic check reproduced **all 14 network
configurations**, including every published mutual-three-neighbor edge and
weight, directly from the public Float32 matrices. Independent standard-library
sorting, set intersections and graph traversal were used, with no producer
function imports. All four preselected source/creator/printed-label joins and
all 16 contrast pair values also matched exactly; bounded values used saved
vectors, not new inference. The private receipt is
`readings/review/graph-h5-independent.json`, SHA-256
`fbd38119bd9c551dbc7095e24b3672ef53d83c8abe19a9b7969d3109d6e500cd`.
Changing the network setting changes its connectivity substantially; these are
text-similarity graphs, not contact or causal networks.

The full speech audit passed at **19:01:28 UTC**. All nine selected recordings
completed: **269 windows**, **132.61 minutes** of exact sample coverage and
**15,300 recognized words**, with 267 new inferences plus two verified pilot
cache hits. Independent whole-waveform decodes, window joins, partial tails,
encoder exhaustion, output assembly and timeline measurements passed. Four
empty windows remain visible. The measured main worker stage lasted **899.39
seconds**, with **891.88 seconds** of observed worker overlap; this is not a
matched serial speedup. A subsequent no-inference invocation verified all nine
completed editions. There were **zero new audio downloads** in this extension.
The receipt `review/asr-full-independent.json` binds the public
[speech artifact](../../dist/channel-lab/batch-asr.json), SHA-256
`3d5e8c11e8cc4be3f5d7598788dc85611b8830d39ae8187be25d2ffb2c087ac8`.
Complete sample coverage and changed text do not establish recognition accuracy,
speaker roles or the truth of a source's claims. New editions do not overwrite
the canonical frame. Contextual-token, edition-sensitivity and actual browser
release checks remain separately scoped.

The remaining numerical reviews subsequently passed: contextual-token selection
and arithmetic at **19:04:08 UTC**, and edition sensitivity at **19:05:19 UTC**.
`review/contextual-independent.json` verifies 24 selected terms, all 921 sampled
occurrences from 208 distinct sources, 587 publisher-context/term means and the
shared projection. These are exploratory token states from a sentence-trained
model, not validated word senses or a semantic ontology. The source-reading role
challenged the edition summary to lead with the nine changed sources rather
than a diluted whole-corpus average. Their mean top-five neighbor Jaccard is
**0.6614 lexical / 0.5780 neural**, compared with **0.9925 / 0.9849** across all
493 sources; only nine representations were replaced. Two lexical and eleven
neural neighbor lists also change among the other 484 sources. The independent
reviewer checked all 1,972 before/after lists and 36 paired cosine values, with
fresh frozen-vocabulary lexical transforms and saved neural-vector arithmetic.
Five primary replacements compare publisher-written messages with recognition
output, so text origin and editorial treatment remain confounded; separate
same-audio recognition pairs have their own explicit scope. High cosine does not
validate the preservation of negation, numbers or factual content. The accepted
[edition-sensitivity artifact](../../dist/channel-lab/asr-effects.json) is bound
by `review/asr-effects-independent.json`, SHA-256
`f24e59afa4d71cad30432c990e484a0d51cd8c7c4703899462daf3bab272a0b5`.
These checks used no second neural inference run and do not establish WER,
causal model superiority or browser/deployment completion.
